operation_details.item: The user's Product A targets enterprise customers.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How is the campaign planning going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Going well. I’m reviewing the audience sections in our strategy doc before the next planning session.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good call. Are the product segments still clearly separated there?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. Product A targets enterprise customers, Product B targets SMB customers, and Product C targets individual consumers.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That distinction should make the campaign briefs easier to keep focused. Are you also checking whether the messaging reflects each segment rather than relying on one default brand voice?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’m tailoring the messaging and customer engagement approach to each audience instead of treating the segments as interchangeable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that Product A targets enterprise customers, while keeping the targeting for Products B and C.
